name: pin_inset_edge
expr: max(2 * (inner_radius + sheet_thickness) + 0.5 mm + max(2 mm, sheet_thickness) + pin_hole / 2, hole_edge_minimum + inner_radius + sheet_thickness - door_reveal + screw_hole / 2) + 0.2 mm

name: cable_y
expr: cabinet_depth - sheet_thickness - inner_radius - back_flange - cable_diameter / 2 - 8 mm

name: cap_screw_y1
expr: cabinet_depth - sheet_thickness - inner_radius - back_flange - nut_body_radius - 6 mm

name: cabinet_area_estimate
expr: 2 * (2 * cap_outer_x + 2 * cap_flange) * (cabinet_depth - tongue_y) + 2 * (cabinet_depth + lip_length) * inside_height + (2 * back_base_x + 2 * back_flange) * (inside_height + 2 * back_flange) + door_on * (2 * door_half_width + 2 * door_flange) * (inside_height + 2 * door_flange) + 2 * (1 + rear_rails) * (rail_high_z - rail_low_z) * (rail_base_x - rail_inner_x + bend_allowance + rail_leg + bend_allowance + rail_return)

name: wall_mass_limit
expr: (2 * fixing_pull_limit * (fixing_lever / 1 mm) - cabinet_mass_estimate * gravity * (0.7 * cabinet_depth / 1 mm)) / (gravity * (gear_lever / 1 mm))

name: gear_mass_max
expr: max(5, min(unit_mass_limit, if(mounting == 1, min(0.95 * wall_mass_limit, sheets[sheet_choice].wall_limit_kg), sheets[sheet_choice].floor_limit_kg))) * 1 kg

title: 19-inch rack cabinet
author: 3DCraft Jigs
description: A wall or floor 19-inch rack cabinet to the EIA-310 / IEC 60297 pattern: tell it how many units, how deep your gear is and what it weighs. Two sides, a lid, a pan, a back plate and rails bolted together with self-clinching nuts, each laser cut and folded from one sheet, with a door on two hinge pins and a quarter-turn lock, cable glands and filler panels. Export: file.export with sheetMetal for Lid, Pan, Side right, Back, Rail right, Door and Panel (or the menu's flat patterns) writes each blank's DXF with its bend lines, nothing to pick.
